candidateDiscoveryRules: Discover active, unshadowed event mean_time_to_happen definitions through the shared index.
eligibilityRules: Evaluate source eligibility and declared candidate overrides with three-valued logic.
adapter.evaluationCadence: daily while active; inactive triggers are polled every 20 days
limitations: The adapter models the verified daily median-hazard check only while the event trigger remains true.
The inactive-trigger 20-day polling cadence is reported separately and is not invented from missing scheduled state.
modifierOrder: Evaluate the base expression, then source add/factor operations and modifiers in source order.
Apply declared external factors only after source-local operations.
poolNormalizationRules: Do not normalize; convert timing only through the verified median-hazard model.
scopeExpectations: event root scope declared by the scenario
supportedExpressions: scenario-bound ROOT/THIS/PREV/FROM scope chains, saved scopes, and event targets
declared dynamic scope-pool filters with uniform or proportional selection
timingConversion: Treat the effective duration as the median of verified daily checks while active.
Bound activation through the verified 20-day inactive polling phase when its phase is undeclared.
unsupportedConstructs: The adapter models the verified daily median-hazard check only while the event trigger remains true.
